{"id":1547269686,"question_id":680,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 5 months","timestamp":1739874126,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1547269686/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Valid Palindrome II","memory":"22.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool IsPalindrome(string &str, int s , int e)\n    {\n        while(s<=e)\n        {\n            if(str[s] != str[e])\n            {\n                return false;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                s++;\n                e--;\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    bool validPalindrome(string s) {\n        int i = 0 , j = s.size()-1 ;\n       \n        while(i <= j)\n        {\n            if(s[i] == s[j])\n            {\n                i++;\n                j--;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                int i_deletion = IsPalindrome(s , i+1 , j);\n\n                int j_deletion = IsPalindrome(s , i , j-1);\n\n                return i_deletion or j_deletion;\n            }\n        }\n    return true;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"valid-palindrome-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":339}
